cues: The main tool is irony, in all three kinds.
Verbal irony: such a son as few women had borne, praise with a mocking edge.
Situational irony: each kindness of the son increases the father's misery.
Dramatic irony: we know the old man means it when he says he is dying; his family thinks he is acting.
And above all, the title, which means one thing in the first half and the opposite in the second.
